evidence.title: Broader market decline on February 27
evidence.text: The S&P 500 fell 1.6%, the Nasdaq Composite fell 2.8%, and the Russell 2000 fell 1.6%. Associated Press reported concerns about possible tariffs and weakness across high-momentum AI shares.
